title: From Answers to Interpretations: Rethinking Ambiguity-Induced Aleatoric Uncertainty Estimation in LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2609.04543v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A key challenge in reliable LLM deployment is recognizing when uncertainty reflects irreducible variability in the task rather than limitations in the model's knowledge. In language tasks, a central source of such aleatoric uncertainty is input ambiguity or underspecification, where multiple interpretations remain plausible. Existing decomposition methods estimate aleatoric uncertainty by generating multiple clarifications of the input, querying the model for an answer under each clarification, and comparing the resulting answers. We argue that answers are not necessary for identifying ambiguity: they are often redundant, add avoidable cost, and can mislead through epistemic leakage. We support this claim theoretically, and propose a clarification-only approach that estimates this ambiguity-induced component directly from the space of plausible interpretations, without answers to the clarified inputs. translated_title: 从答案到解释：重新思考大语言模型中由歧义引起的偶然不确定性估计
translated_abstract: 可靠部署大语言模型的一个关键挑战是识别不确定性何时反映了任务本身不可还原的变异性，而非模型知识的局限性。在语言任务中，这种偶然不确定性的一个核心来源是输入的歧义或欠规范，即多种解释依然合理。现有的分解方法通过为输入生成多个澄清版本、在每个澄清版本下查询模型答案、再比较所得答案来估计偶然不确定性。我们认为，识别歧义并不需要答案：答案往往是冗余的，会增加可避免的成本，并可能通过认知泄漏产生误导。我们从理论上支持了这一主张，并提出一种仅基于澄清的方法，直接从合理解释的空间中估计这种由歧义引起的成分，而无需对澄清后的输入给出答案。以歧义检测作为一项操作任务（摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出一种无需生成答案的“仅澄清”方法，直接从合理解释空间估计大语言模型中由输入歧义引起的偶然不确定性，从而降低成本并避免答案带来的认知泄漏误导。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an answer-free, clarification-only approach that directly estimates ambiguity-induced aleatoric uncertainty in LLMs from the space of plausible interpretations, reducing cost and avoiding epistemic leakage caused by answers.
